name: Auth.js (NextAuth v5)
description: Standalone Auth.js v5 setup: Google/GitHub/Credentials providers, Edge-safe config split, JWT session strategy, typed session.user, and matcher-based route protection middleware
checklist: Install dependencies: npm install next-auth@beta bcryptjs (add @auth/prisma-adapter if session_strategy=database)
Set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID/SECRET and AUTH_GITHUB_ID/SECRET from each provider console
Set AUTH_URL to your deployment URL (required in production)
Remove any providers you don't use from src/auth.config.ts and src/auth.ts
For Credentials login, implement lookupUser() in src/auth.ts against your user store
Standalone framework — conflicts with all Group A adapters and the other Group B frameworks; use only one auth strategy
Test flow: GET /api/auth/signin → provider → redirect back; protected paths require a session
